title: Old Fashioned Silky Canadian Morcilla Pasta
description: A fermented, silky, and cozy Canadian dish featuring morcilla and a pasta water emulsion, suitable for a satvik friendly diet. This dish is a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Slice the morcilla into thin rounds and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the garlic and onion until softened.
Add the sliced morcilla to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Add the vegetable broth, white wine, and nutritional yeast to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until the liquid has reduced slightly.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the pasta and add it to the skillet with the morcilla mixture.
Stir the pasta water into the morcilla mixture to create a silky emulsion.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the morcilla and sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
